entries.label: Why do you want to work at Acme?
Tell us about a project you are proud of
entries.value:
The project I'm proudest of is ClarityAtlas, an iOS health product I co-founded Open Health Intelligence to build and serve as technical lead for. I built it end to end in Swift and SwiftUI with a Supabase backend. The hardest technical piece was estimating sleep without requiring a wearable, so I built a passive sleep-estimation system from phone-interaction and motion signals using HealthKit and Core Motion inputs like step count, gait speed, and movement patterns. I also built the backend matching services, including a "Sleep Twins" system that compares users on standardized behavioral features with a weighted distance. The product thesis was that people should be able to see relationships between their own behavior, sleep, and movement rather than stare at isolated metrics.

We shipped it into a live pilot at Hopkins with 30+ users, got into the Pava Spark Accelerator and NSF I-Corps, and received a non-binding investment indication of around $75,000 for roughly 7-8% equity, which we chose not to pursue immediately because we wanted the right long-term partners. What I took from it is that building the thing is maybe half the work. Recruiting users, talking to stakeholders, and repeatedly explaining why it should exist mattered just as much.
